source_snapshot.procedure: Press physical UID button once from Off and once from On.
source_snapshot.criteria: Off toggles On; On toggles Off.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; human physical actuation and observation.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/MEDIUM; explicit initial/final state and software readback only supplemental.

historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-02/05/06 require identity/state oracle; ED-04/07/08 require safe access; ED-36/38 reserve verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify the designated physical UID button toggles the corresponding visible UID indicator from Off to On and then On to Off, without affecting the wrong node or leaving an inconsistent state.
original_method: Identify SUT/node, button and indicator; establish physical and BMC-reported Off baseline; qualified operator performs one bounded press and captures On transition, then after settling performs one bounded press and captures Off transition; correlate event/readback and finish Off.
manual_activity: Qualified operator presses the named button and visually records the mapped indicator; agent may capture BMC readback/events.
required_inputs: Expected color/mode for On and exact Off state
Press duration, debounce and settle interval
Approved supplemental BMC readback/event and final Off requirement
safety_requirements: Verify the physical target before pressing
Use one measured press per transition and wait for debounce
Record physical state; do not infer it from software alone
Stop on wrong-node response, stuck button or disagreement; avoid repeated presses
agent_execution_scope: Collect initial/intermediate/final readback and logs and analyze photos/video
Do not actuate hardware, substitute remote command for the button, repeat presses, mask disagreement or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve button/indicator/node mapping and state appearance
Review two transition evidence and decide verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No remote command exercises the physical button contact; remote state is corroboration only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Pair SUT-linked video of each physical press/state with timestamped BMC Indicator/identify readback and events.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Off-to-On and On-to-Off button transitions remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record two isolated physical transitions with initial/final visual and digital state plus debounce timing.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact identity, timing, correlation, wrong-node detection and guaranteed final Off.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Remote LED control would test the controller, not the physical button input path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Button bounce or delayed BMC propagation can create multiple transitions; timing and a single press are necessary.

project_override_considerations: If front and rear UID buttons or LEDs exist, engineering must state which controls/indicators are in scope and whether both must be covered.
expected_evidence: Off baseline, first press and On visual/readback/event
Debounce/settle timestamps, final Off and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently define the two inverse toggle transitions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: This is a valid manual test when safe physical access and target mapping are provided.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2265 Wistron-HW-00371-V004: approve chassis/node mapping for the physical UID button and visible indicator(s), expected On color/mode and Off appearance, press duration/debounce/settle window, supplemental BMC readback/event mapping, wrong-node handling and mandatory final Off state; state whether front/rear controls both require coverage.

review_improvement: Preserves both physical toggle transitions while preventing remote control or software readback from replacing the button and visible indicator path.
independent_technical_reasoning: The physical button input, BMC state variable and LED output are three distinct links. A software value can change even if the button is defective or the LED is miswired, and switch bounce can toggle twice. Reliable evidence therefore starts from known Off, uses one measured press per transition, observes the physical indicator and correlates digital state after a settle window, ending Off.
